attempted_claim: Let F be a p-adic field of characteristic 0 and G=SO(V_{2n}) a non-quasi-split even special orthogonal group (e.g. disc=1, Hasse-Witt -1, n>=2), with quasi-split inner form G*, Whittaker datum w, and pure inner twist (rho,z):G*->G with Kaletha transfer factor Delta[w,e,z]. For every tempered L-parameter phi of G and every elliptic endoscopic triple e=(G^e,s_e,xi^e) with phi^e mapping to phi, prove the pure-inner local intertwining relation R_{c'}(w,tau x sigma)|_{sigma'}=iota_{c'}(sigma')(a) for the Chen-Zou tempered packet and hence the Kaletha-normalized endoscopic character identity refined from O(V)-orbits to SO(V)(F)-conjugacy classes, including Whittaker-datum variation and generic/unramified characterizations, for Delta[w,e,z]-matching test functions.
decisive_failure: Two credible routes (trace-formula/Kaletha comparison; Chen-Zou theta transport) plus a bounded n=2 recovery model were attempted; all terminate at one structural obstruction (pure-inner outer-automorphism refinement from O-orbits to SO(F)-classes) requiring a new disconnected stabilization beyond the bounded pass. No literature search was consumed and no partial claim is asserted.
